samples.xml_description:
<module id="traffic_light">
    <description>A traffic light system with red, yellow, and green indicators, and a pedestrian crossing request button.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="pass_request">Request signal for pedestrians to cross.</input>
        <output id="clock" width_description="[7:0]">Count value of the internal counter.</output>
        <output id="red">Red signal for the traffic light.</output>
        <output id="yellow">Yellow signal for the traffic light.</output>
        <output id="green">Green signal for the traffic light.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <enum id="idle">Initial state.</enum>
        <enum id="s1_red">State after red signal.</enum>
        <enum id="s2_yellow">State after yellow signal.</enum>
        <enum id="s3_green">State after green signal.</enum>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[7:0]">Internal counter for timing control.</reg>
        <reg id="state" width_description="[1:0]">Current state of the traffic light controller.</reg>
        <reg id="p_red">Previous value of red signal.</reg>
        <reg id="p_yellow">Previous value of yellow signal.</reg>
        <reg id="p_green">Previous value of green signal.</reg>
        
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                state <= idle;
            end else begin
                case(state)
                    idle: state <= s1_red;
                    s1_red: begin
                        if(cnt == 3) begin
                            state <= s3_green;
                        end else begin
                            state <= s1_red;
                        end
                    end
                    s2_yellow: begin
                        if(cnt == 3) begin
                            state <= s1_red;
                        end else begin
                            state <= s2_yellow;
                        end
                    end
                    s3_green: begin
                        if(cnt == 3) begin
                            state <= s2_yellow;
                        end else begin
                            state <= s3_green;
                        end
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
        
        // Counting logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 10;
            end else begin
                if(pass_request && green) begin
                    cnt <= 10;
                end else if(!green && p_green) begin
                    cnt <= 60;
                end else if(!yellow && p_yellow) begin
                    cnt <= 5;
                end else if(!red && p_red) begin
                    cnt <= 10;
                end else begin
                    cnt <= cnt - 1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Assign statements for outputs
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if(!rst_n) begin
                {p_red, p_yellow, p_green} <= 3'b000;
            end else begin
                {p_red, p_yellow, p_green} <= {red, yellow, green};
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Design your traffic light controller here.</implementation>
    <task>
        <description>Task to update the state of the traffic light controller.</description>
        <param id="state">Current state of the traffic light controller.</param>
        <param id="next_state">Next state of the traffic light controller.</param>
        <param id="cnt">Internal counter for timing control.</param>
        <param id="p_red">Previous value of red signal.</param>
        <param id="p_yellow">Previous value of yellow signal.</param>
        <param id="p_green">Previous value of green signal.</param>
        <param id="pass_request">Request signal for pedestrians to cross.</param>
        <param id="red">Red signal for the traffic light.</param>
        <param id="yellow">Yellow signal for the traffic light.</param>
        <param id="green">Green signal for the traffic light.</param>
        <param id="clk">Clock signal.</param>
        <param id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</param>
        <param id="clock">Count value of the internal counter.</param>
        <begin>
            <if condition="!rst_n">
                <set target="state" value="idle"/>
            </if>
            <else>
                <case source="state">
                    <item value="idle">
                        <set target="state" value="s1_red"/>
                    </item>
                    <item value="s1_red">
                        <if condition="cnt == 3">
                            <set target="state" value="s3_green"/>
                        </if>
                        <else>
                            <set target="state" value="s1_red"/>
                        </else>
                    </item>
                    <item value="s2_yellow">
                        <if condition="cnt == 3">
                            <set target="state" value="s1_red"/>
                        </if>
                        <else>
                            <set target="state" value="s2_yellow"/>
                        </else>
                    </item>
                    <item value="s3_green">
                        <if condition="cnt == 3">
                            <set target="state" value="s2_yellow"/>
                        </if>
                        <else>
                            <set target="state" value="s3_green"/>
                        </else>
                    </item>
                </case>
                
                <if condition="!green && p_green">
                    <set target="cnt" value="60"/>
                </if>
                <else if("!yellow && p_yellow") begin
                    <set target="cnt" value="5"/>
                </if>
                <else if("!red && p_red") begin
                    <set target="cnt" value="10"/>
                </else if("pass_request && green") begin
                    <set target="cnt" value="10"/>
                end
                <else begin
                    <set target="cnt" value="cnt - 1"/>
                </end
                
                <assign target="clock" source="cnt"/>
            </else>
        </begin>
    </task>
</module>
